title: SCA Tish'a BeAb 2022: Mr. Harold Shamah

chapters.title: The Concept of Escape the Room

summary: Mr. Shamah discusses the concept of 'Escape the Room' as a way to understand life's challenges and the importance of maintaining a connection to Hashem. He explains that life is a series of experiences designed to help individuals reach their maximum potential and achieve ultimate joy.
questions: How can we move forward in life when facing problems?
What is the true purpose of the Beit HaMikdash?
Why does Hashem allow bad things to happen?
How can we use prayer to connect with Hashem?
